Additional Properties.description: Additional Properties  allow arbitrary properties not defined in the type definitions to be added to any referenceable element.

Anchor Scope IDs.description: A list of IDs that are anchor scopes for this element.

Category.description: A user-defined category for the element, used to group related elements for display or search purposes.

Confidence Classification.description: Classification from 0422. Structure: {status_identifier: int, confidence: int, steward: str, steward_type_name: str, steward_property_name: str, source: str, notes: str, level_identifier: int}. level_identifier uses ConfidenceLevel enum: UNCLASSIFIED=0, AD_HOC=1, TRANSACTIONAL=2, AUTHORITATIVE=3, DERIVED=4, OBSOLETE=5, OTHER=99.

Confidentiality Classification.description: Classification from 0422. Structure: {status_identifier: int, confidence: int, steward: str, steward_type_name: str, steward_property_name: str, source: str, notes: str, level_identifier: int}. level_identifier uses ConfidentialityLevel enum: UNCLASSIFIED=0, INTERNAL=1, CONFIDENTIAL=2, SENSITIVE=3, RESTRICTED=4, OTHER=99.

Content Status.description: The lifecycle status of an element.

Criticality Classification.description: Classification from 0422. Structure: {status_identifier: int, confidence: int, steward: str, steward_type_name: str, steward_property_name: str, source: str, notes: str, level_identifier: int}. level_identifier uses CriticalityLevel enum: UNCLASSIFIED=0, MARGINAL=1, IMPORTANT=2, CRITICAL=3, CATASTROPHIC=4, OTHER=99.

Display Name.description: The common name of an element.

Effective From.description: The beginning of when an element is viewable.

Effective Time.description: The time at which an element must be effective in order to be returned by the request.

Effective To.description: The ending time at which an element is visible.

Extended Properties.description: A dictionary of properties that extend the properties of an entity type.

External Source GUID.description: The unique identifier of an external source.

External Source Name.description: The name of an external source

For Duplicate Processing.description: Flag indicating if the request is to support duplicate processing.

For Lineage.description: Flag indicating if the request is to support lineage.

GUID.description: A unique identifier - typically of an element in this context.

Glossary Term.description: Term that provides meaning to this field.

Impact Classification.description: Classification from 0422. Structure: {status_identifier: int, confidence: int, steward: str, steward_type_name: str, steward_property_name: str, source: str, notes: str, severity_identifier: int}. severity_identifier uses ImpactSeverity enum: UNCLASSIFIED=0, LOW=1, MEDIUM=2, HIGH=3, OTHER=99.

Implementation Description.description: Describes how this governance control is implemented.

Is Own Anchor.description: A flag indicating if the element is its own anchor or is anchored to a different element.

Journal Entry.description: A text entry into a journal.

Label.description: A label used to identify or categorise a relationship link.

Legal.description: Copyright and/or license information for the element or associated resource.

Make Anchor.description: Is the element at end2 an anchor to end1?

Merge Update.description: A flag indicating if the update should be a merge or replace.

Parent Relationship Attributes.description: A dictionary of relationship attributes to establish the parent relationship.

Parent at End1.description: A flag indicating if the parent is at end1 of the relationship

Policy Management Point.description: Combined classification from 0435. Applied to Referenceable. Structure: {point_type: str, name: str, description: str}. point_type is one of: PolicyAdministrationPoint, PolicyDecisionPoint, PolicyEnforcementPoint, PolicyInformationPoint, PolicyRetrievalPoint. A Referenceable may have multiple policy management point classifications simultaneously.

Qualified Name.description: The unique, text name of an element.

Request ID.description: A user provided or system generated request id for a conversation.

Retention Classification.description: Classification from 0422. Structure: {status_identifier: int, confidence: int, steward: str, steward_type_name: str, steward_property_name: str, source: str, notes: str, basis_identifier: int, associated_guid: str, archive_after: date, delete_after: date}. basis_identifier uses RetentionBasis enum: UNCLASSIFIED=0, TEMPORARY=1, PROJECT_LIFETIME=2, TEAM_LIFETIME=3, CONTRACT_LIFETIME=4, REGULATED_LIFETIME=5, TIMEBOXED_LIFETIME=6, OTHER=99.

Scope.description: Scope of the definition or element.

Security Tags.description: Optional security tags for security processing.

Status.description: Repository or element header status for an element.

User Defined Content Status.description: A user defined content status = only valid if content status is OTHER.

Zone Membership.description: Zones scope visibility of elements to different users.

Review Date.description: When the statement, or this control's applicability, was last reviewed.

Certification Standard.description: The certification type (standard) the statement of applicability is assessed against. Linked with a GovernedBy relationship.

Scoped By.description: Elements, such as an organization, site or system, that define the scope the statement covers. Each is linked with a ScopedBy relationship.

Statement of Applicability.description: The statement of applicability the control is assessed in.

Control.description: The governance definition describing the control being assessed - typically a GovernanceControl from a standard.

Is Applicable.description: Whether the control applies. Egeria treats a control as applicable unless this is false.

Justification.description: Why the control is included or excluded.

Inclusion Reasons.description: Why the control is included. Suggested values: Risk Treatment, Legal or Regulatory Requirement, Contractual Obligation, Business Requirement, Best Practice.

Implementation Status.description: How far the control has been implemented. Egeria defaults a new link to NOT_STARTED.

Purpose.description: The purpose of this collection — a short description of why it exists or what it is used for.

Start Time.description: Date/time (ISO 8601) that the work started - for a promise, work on delivering the promised resource; for a report, the run that produced it.
Start Time.Journal Entry: Added 2026-09-30 -- Promise classification (0010), Classification Explorer setElementAsPromise.

Completion Time.description: Date/time (ISO 8601) that the work finished - for a promise, when the promised resource was delivered; for a report, when the run completed.
Completion Time.Journal Entry: Added 2026-09-30 -- Promise classification (0010), Classification Explorer setElementAsPromise.

Summary.description: A short summary of the element's meaning or purpose.

Report Subjects.description: The assets or other elements that the run tested. Each is linked with a ReportSubject relationship.

Survey Report.description: The survey report for the test run this belongs to. Linked with a ReportedAnnotation relationship.

Severity.description: The CVSS severity rating of the finding.

Vulnerability Identifiers.description: Identifiers of the vulnerability, such as CVE identifiers.

Weakness Identifiers.description: Identifiers of the weakness, such as CWE identifiers.

Affected Location.description: Where the finding is: host and port, URL, file path or package.

Evidence.description: What demonstrated the finding, such as the request and response.

Exploit Available.description: Whether an exploit is publicly available.

Affected Elements.description: Catalogued elements the finding affects - the tested asset, and any catalogued element at the affected location or among the compromised resources. Each is linked with an AssociatedAnnotation relationship.

Previous Finding.description: The same finding in an earlier run. Linked with an AnnotationExtension relationship.

Vulnerability Type.description: A reference data value naming the type of vulnerability. Linked with a ReferenceValueAssignment relationship.

Package URL.description: Package URL (purl) of the vulnerable software.

Installed Version.description: The installed version of the vulnerable software.

Fixed Version.description: The first version with the fix.

Attack Vector.description: How the weakness was reached, such as Network, Adjacent network, Local, Physical or Social engineering.

Attack Techniques.description: Techniques used, such as MITRE ATT&CK technique identifiers.

Compromised Resources.description: Names of the resources reached or controlled.

Finding Counts By Severity.description: Number of findings at each severity, one 'severity: count' pair per line (or a JSON object).

Resources In Scope Count.description: Number of resources in scope for the run.

Resources Tested Count.description: Number of resources the run tested.

New Finding Count.description: Findings seen for the first time in this run.

Resolved Finding Count.description: Findings from earlier runs that are no longer detected.

Create Statement of Applicability.description: A statement of applicability records which controls from a standard, such as ISO/IEC 27001 Annex A, apply to the organization, why, and how far each is implemented.

Link Control Applicability.description: Record whether a control applies to a statement of applicability, why, and how far it is implemented. Linking a control that is already linked updates its applicability.

Create Survey Report.description: A survey report catalogues one run of an analysis, such as a vulnerability scan or penetration test. Category says what kind of test it was, for example Penetration Test Results.

Create Security Finding.description: A security finding from a test run that is neither a known vulnerability nor a penetration test finding, such as an insecure configuration.

Create Vulnerability Finding.description: A known vulnerability in the software a resource uses, typically from a vulnerability scan.

Create Penetration Test Finding.description: A weakness a penetration test was able to exploit.

Create Security Posture Summary.description: The summary of one security test run: findings by severity, resources in scope and tested, and new and resolved findings.
